data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 7.2m (2018: GBP 68.9m) is an improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to close of 2016 & Prior years
prior_year_events.impact_description: At 31 December 2018 the 2016 & Prior years of account closed by way of an external reinsurance to close agreement; this is reflected as an RITC adjustment removing gross claims provision of GBP 251.160m from opening balances.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 321.993m at 1 January 2019. The syndicate reports a small improvement in prior year reserves (an improvement of GBP 1.0m, net) driven by favourable development in Property, Aviation and Marine classes, partially offset by unfavourable development in other classes. The prior year balances were materially affected by a reinsurance to close of the 2016 & prior years at 31 December 2018 which reduced carried gross reserves by c. GBP 251.16m.
raw_causal_phrases: improvement of GBP 1.0m (2018: deterioration of GBP 3.3m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments on Property, Aviation and Marine classes with partially offsetting unfavourable developments across the other classes.
Actual vs expected claims development was favourable in the period driven by the Professional Indemnity and Property Binders classes.
At 31 December 2018 the 2016 & Prior years of account closed by way of an external reinsurance to close agreement.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, liabilities) 2018 comparative column. No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was published; the report only states a net improvement of GBP 1.0m to prior year reserves (used as a last-resort fallback - NET of reinsurance). The 2016 & Prior reinsurance-to-close (RITC) materially altered opening/closing balances (RITC adjustment shown as GBP 251.160k) which distorts simple movement interpretations and limits confidence in computing a gross PYD. Gross premium mix percentages are computed against a negative total premium written (-GBP 1.375m) which produces counter-intuitive signed percentages; amounts are exact per note (in thousands converted to millions).
